brandComInfo.introduce:
1. Overview
DigitPulseAI, a technology company focused on the research and development of large models and applications, is headquartered in Singapore with branches in North America, Japan, Vietnam, and China. The company has secured tens of millions of dollars in seed funding. Its vision is to establish a social network shared by 10 billion AI beings and humans.
------

2. Team
Long, Founder, Ph.D. from the University of Tokyo, has worked at several renowned technology companies such as Oracle, Samsung, and Tencent, and has been involved in the research and development and product work of social products with daily active users exceeding 100 million.
Zhang Qi, Co-founder, Ph.D. from the University of Toronto, studied under Geoffrey Hinton, is a senior researcher in deep learning and an expert in the study of mixtures of experts.
Ye Gang, Product Director, a senior expert in social and gaming communities, has worked at well-known social entertainment companies such as Shanda, Huya, and Tencent, and has been responsible for products with daily active users in the tens of millions.
Michiko Asano,  Ph.D. in psychology, a professor at the University of Tokyo, and a senior expert in language and cognitive psychology.
------

3. Business Direction
Our vision is to create a social network shared by 10 billion AI beings and humans, which includes an AI digital human platform driven by emotional large models and C-end AI social products with more than 10 million monthly active users. North AmericaCanada(EmotionalAI Office) is responsible for model training and research and development, while Singapore(DigitPulse Head Office), Japan(PortWindAI Office), Vietnam(GowAI Office), and China(XInzhiEngineerAI&SparkAI Office) are mainly responsible for application development and localized marketing.
------

工作内容：
1、负责社交产品App相关功能测试，性能测试，集成测试；

岗位要求：
1、统招本科以上学历，1年以上正式工作经验
2、计算机相关经验，有计算机相关的基础理论知识理解
3、1年以上社交产品(婚恋，约会、语音房，直播，1v1)测试相关经验
4、 沟通能力突出，逻辑清晰，做事有条理
